name: local-agent-workbench
description: A Copilot-free, Agents-style workbench for local Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI sessions.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Local coding agents can read files, edit files, and run commands. Trust the workspace before starting an agent.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The extension launches local CLI processes and requires a local filesystem.

commands.title: Local Agents: Open Workbench in New Window

localAgentWorkbench.dataDirectory.description: Directory used for Local Agent Workbench metadata. Tilde expansion is supported.

localAgentWorkbench.claude.executable.description: Claude Code executable name or absolute path.

localAgentWorkbench.claude.userDirectory.description: Claude Code user directory used for authentication, settings, and session discovery.

localAgentWorkbench.claude.defaultModel.description: Default Claude model or alias. Leave empty to use Claude Code configuration.

localAgentWorkbench.codex.executable.description: Codex CLI executable name or absolute path.

localAgentWorkbench.codex.userDirectory.description: Codex home used for authentication, config.toml, rules, skills, and session discovery.

localAgentWorkbench.codex.defaultModel.description: Default Codex model. Leave empty to use the active Codex configuration.

enumDescriptions: Read files but deny edits and mutating commands.
Allow edits and commands inside the selected workspace.
Bypass provider approvals and sandboxing. Use only in an external sandbox.
localAgentWorkbench.defaultPermission.description: Default permission boundary for new sessions.

localAgentWorkbench.showStatusBarButton.description: Show a Local Agents toggle in the VS Code status bar.

localAgentWorkbench.appearance.accent.description: CSS color used as the workbench accent.

localAgentWorkbench.appearance.density.description: Default information density of the custom workbench.

localAgentWorkbench.discovery.maxSession.description: Maximum number of native Claude and Codex sessions scanned from the user directories.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:ui && npm run test && npm run build
